endpoints.summary: Gets a list of Time Tracking Projects.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: The name of the project.

fields.name: CustomerID
fields.description: Customer ID allocated to the Project.

fields.name: Customer
fields.description: Customer allocated to the Project.

fields.name: BillingMethodID
fields.description: The billing method to be used for the project: 1. Single Project Rate. 2. Project Rate Per Hour. 3. Staff Rate Per Hour. 4. Task Rate Per Hour.

fields.name: InvoicingMethodID
fields.description: The invoice method to be used for the project: 1. Task Detailed. 2. Group By Task. 3. Consolidated.

fields.name: EstimatedHours
fields.description: Estimate Hours set for a Project

fields.name: EstimatedValue
fields.description: Estimate Value of a Project

fields.name: FixedRate
fields.description: Project Fixed Rate when billing method is set to Single Project Rate.

fields.name: RatePerHour
fields.description: Project Rate Per Hour when billing method is set to Project Rate Per Hour.

fields.name: ProjectTasks
fields.type: Collection of Time Tracking Project Task
fields.description: Represents a lookup record between a Project and a Task. This is being used by Time Sheets to set Billing Rates and Budget Hours

fields.name: ProjectStaff
fields.type: Collection of Time Tracking Project Staff

fields.name: Tasks
fields.description: Tasks which is curently linked to a project.

fields.name: BudgetBasedOn
fields.description: Budget based on: 1. Project 2. Task

endpoints.summary: Retrieves an array of Time Tracking Projects for a User

fields.name: Name
fields.description: The name of the project.

fields.name: CustomerID
fields.description: Customer ID allocated to the Project.

fields.name: Customer
fields.description: Customer allocated to the Project.

fields.name: BillingMethodID
fields.description: The billing method to be used for the project: 1. Single Project Rate. 2. Project Rate Per Hour. 3. Staff Rate Per Hour. 4. Task Rate Per Hour.

fields.name: InvoicingMethodID
fields.description: The invoice method to be used for the project: 1. Task Detailed. 2. Group By Task. 3. Consolidated.

fields.name: EstimatedHours
fields.description: Estimate Hours set for a Project

fields.name: EstimatedValue
fields.description: Estimate Value of a Project

fields.name: FixedRate
fields.description: Project Fixed Rate when billing method is set to Single Project Rate.

fields.name: RatePerHour
fields.description: Project Rate Per Hour when billing method is set to Project Rate Per Hour.

fields.name: ProjectTasks
fields.type: Collection of Time Tracking Project Task
fields.description: Represents a lookup record between a Project and a Task. This is being used by Time Sheets to set Billing Rates and Budget Hours

fields.name: ProjectStaff
fields.type: Collection of Time Tracking Project Staff

fields.name: Tasks
fields.description: Tasks which is curently linked to a project.

fields.name: BudgetBasedOn
fields.description: Budget based on: 1. Project 2. Task

fields.name: Name
fields.description: The name of the project.

fields.name: CustomerID
fields.description: Customer ID allocated to the Project.

fields.name: Customer
fields.description: Customer allocated to the Project.

fields.name: BillingMethodID
fields.description: The billing method to be used for the project: 1. Single Project Rate. 2. Project Rate Per Hour. 3. Staff Rate Per Hour. 4. Task Rate Per Hour.

fields.name: InvoicingMethodID
fields.description: The invoice method to be used for the project: 1. Task Detailed. 2. Group By Task. 3. Consolidated.

fields.name: EstimatedHours
fields.description: Estimate Hours set for a Project

fields.name: EstimatedValue
fields.description: Estimate Value of a Project

fields.name: FixedRate
fields.description: Project Fixed Rate when billing method is set to Single Project Rate.

fields.name: RatePerHour
fields.description: Project Rate Per Hour when billing method is set to Project Rate Per Hour.

fields.name: ProjectTasks
fields.type: Collection of Time Tracking Project Task
fields.description: Represents a lookup record between a Project and a Task. This is being used by Time Sheets to set Billing Rates and Budget Hours

fields.name: ProjectStaff
fields.type: Collection of Time Tracking Project Staff

fields.name: Tasks
fields.description: Tasks which is curently linked to a project.

fields.name: BudgetBasedOn
fields.description: Budget based on: 1. Project 2. Task
